summary: Backend + frontend verification of AI Studio presentation video feature. Backend: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_videos.py — 3/3 pass (auth required, type/size rejection, chunked upload + range streaming). Frontend (admin + preview, Chromium): logged in with admin@outsidersproduction.ma, opened Contenu du site > 'AI Studio — vidéos', expanded new 'Vidéo de présentation (sous le texte d'intro)' block (Image + Vidéo fields), uploaded /app/backend/tests/fixtures/sample.mp4 (991 KB) via cms-video-file-aiStudioMedia.presentation.video — progress bar cms-video-progress-aiStudioMedia.presentation.video appeared, toast 'Vidéo importée — pensez à enregistrer' shown, field value set to /api/media/video/<id>, and after debounce localStorage op-preview-draft.aiStudioMedia.presentation.video matches. Opened /ai-studio?preview=1: section data-testid=ai-presentation renders between ai-text and ai-services (DOM order lead=16, text=17, presentation=18, services=21) with label 'Vidéo de présentation'; ai-presentation-player shows cover + play; clicking play reveals ai-presentation-player-video whose currentSrc ends with /api/media/video/<id> and readyState=4, error=null. YouTube link https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aqz-KE-bpKQ renders ai-presentation-player-iframe (youtube.com/embed/aqz-KE-bpKQ). Empty presentation.video hides ai-presentation (count=0). Mobile 390: player bounding box 350x196.875 (16:9 ratio=1.7778, full width minus px-5 padding). EN: admin label 'Presentation video (under the intro text)' and upload button title exactly 'Upload a video file (500 MB max)'; EN public site section label 'Presentation video'. No content was saved (draft only; localStorage cleared at end). No console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: VideoField.jsx: chunked upload via /api/admin/videos/init|chunk|complete works well; onProgress UI is clean. Good use of 5MB slices to stay under proxy limits.
InlineVideo.jsx correctly branches on toPlayable kind (iframe vs file) and uses cover image as poster for video playback.
AiStudio Presentation section is correctly gated on p.video truthiness and uses PageShell/Reveal styling consistent with the rest of the page.
ContentEditor debounces draft -> localStorage by 300ms; any post-change assertion in tests must wait >=300ms (now documented).
seed_data_creation: Two uploaded video files remain in GridFS (TEST uploads). Content document was not modified — draft only, cleared from localStorage after tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: AI Studio presentation video block is under tab aiStudioMedia; the collapsed 'Vidéo de présentation (sous le texte d'intro)' group must be clicked to expand before testids cms-upload-video-aiStudioMedia.presentation.video / cms-video-file-aiStudioMedia.presentation.video become visible. Admin lang toggle is a button with text 'en'/'fr' in the admin header. ContentEditor debounces draft write to op-preview-draft by 300ms — always wait before reading localStorage.
